If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
Happy Wax does have a Happiness Guarantee for eligible scent exchanges.
Here’s what I found:
Customers are eligible for up to 5 free Happiness Guarantee exchanges in a rolling 365-day period.
After the 5th exchange, additional eligible requests may receive a $5 account credit, up to 12 total Happiness Guarantee claims per year.
The same scent cannot be claimed more than once under the Happiness Guarantee.
If a claim is approved, any reward points earned from the original purchase of that scent are deducted.
A few important exclusions to keep in mind:
Gift sets are not eligible for replacement.
Collection Packs are not eligible for full replacements.
For Collection Packs, single pouches within the pack may qualify for replacement at Happy Wax’s discretion.
Collection Packs cannot be returned through the return portal and require contacting Customer Service for help.
Seasonal Subscription Boxes, Discovery Kits, Mystery Boxes, Exclusive Limited Edition scents, and Last Chance items are also not eligible for replacement.
So, if you’re giving a gift set or bundle, the exchange options may be limited depending on which type you choose.
A Collection Pack may offer some flexibility for individual pouches, but a gift set is specifically listed as not eligible for replacement.
